# Requirements Quality Checklist: Core Audio Playback Engine

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of requirements in the spec, contracts, and plan — with emphasis on edge case traceability and extension API stability definition.
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 — Are explicit functional requirements defined for every edge case listed in the spec? The six edge cases (truncated/corrupt file, format-detected-but-decode-fails/DRM, device disconnect, zero-duration file, seek-beyond-duration, concurrent commands) each need a corresponding FR or acceptance scenario. [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 — Are requirements defined for the IPC socket lifecycle (creation, permissions, cleanup on exit, stale socket handling)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004/FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 — Are requirements specified for what happens when the IPC socket file already exists from a previous crashed instance? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 — Are error response formats specified for ALL IPC commands, or only the subset shown in the contract? `resume`, `stop`, and `list_decoders` lack documented error responses. [Completeness, Contract §IPC Commands]
- [ ] CHK005 — Are volume control requirements defined? The IPC status response includes a `"volume"` field, but no functional requirement or command exists for setting volume. [Gap, Contract §IPC Status]
- [ ] CHK006 — Are requirements defined for what happens when `load_decoder` is called with a path that is not a valid shared library? The contract lists the error response but no acceptance scenario validates it. [Completeness, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK007 — Are extension unload requirements defined with explicit behavior for in-progress playback using the unloaded decoder? US3 scenario 3 mentions "stops gracefully with an error" but FR-007/FR-016 don't restate this. [Completeness, Spec §US3 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK008 — Are format detection requirements defined for sources where the file extension is missing or misleading AND magic bytes are also unrecognized? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 — Are requirements defined for `load_decoder_bytes` temp file cleanup when the engine process is killed (SIGKILL) mid-load? [Gap, Spec §FR-016b]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 — Is "gracefully" in FR-010 quantified or specified with concrete behavior for each error category? The term appears in FR-010 and US3 Scenario 3 without measurable criteria. [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 — Is "immediately" in US1 Scenario 2 (Ctrl+C → "playback stops immediately") quantified with a timeout? SC-008 specifies 500ms for stop command — is Ctrl+C held to the same bound? [Clarity, Spec §US1 Scenario 2 vs SC-008]
- [ ] CHK012 — Is "within 2 seconds" (SC-001 "start playback within 2 seconds") measured from process launch, from `play` command receipt, or from first audio sample? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 — Is "consumer hardware" (SC-001, SC-004) defined with a reference baseline? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001/SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 — Are "default search paths" and "system-wide paths" (FR-007) explicitly enumerated for each target platform? The plan mentions `~/.local/share/around/decoders/` but system paths are unspecified. [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 — Is "position" in FR-005 and US2 Scenario 3 defined with units? The spec uses "position" without specifying milliseconds, samples, or bytes — IPC contract uses `position_ms`. [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005 vs Contract §IPC Status]
- [ ] CHK016 — Is the `Decoder` trait's `seek()` offset unit specified? The contract declares `seek(offset: u64)` without stating whether offset is in bytes, samples, or milliseconds. [Ambiguity, Contract §Decoder Trait]
- [ ] CHK017 — Is "concurrent commands" (Edge Cases) scoped — does it mean concurrent IPC connections, interleaved commands on one connection, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 — Are "corrupted" and "truncated" defined with distinguishing criteria? The spec uses both terms for different edge cases but doesn't define the boundary between them. [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK019 — Does the `PlaybackStatus` type (PLAYING/PAUSED/STOPPED) align with the IPC status response including `"volume"` which has no corresponding command? [Consistency, Data Model §PlaybackStatus vs Contract §IPC Status]
- [ ] CHK020 — Do the `SampleSpec` channel validation (1..=32) and `ChannelLayout` constants (max 8 for 7.1) align? The data model validates up to 32 channels but the layout constants only go to 8. [Consistency, Data Model §SampleSpec vs §ChannelLayout]
- [ ] CHK021 — Does the contract test requirement for "a dummy Source" (decoder-trait.md test fixtures) align with FR-009 which only requires a local filesystem `Source` implementation? [Consistency, Contract §Decoder Trait vs Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK022 — Are the IPC error codes consistent between the IPC contract and the `AroundError` enum in the data model? `FILE_NOT_FOUND` ↔ `AroundError::FileNotFound`; `DECODER_LOAD_FAILED` ↔ `AroundError::DecoderLoadFailed` — verify one-to-one mapping exists. [Consistency, Contract §IPC Error Codes vs Data Model §AroundError]
- [ ] CHK023 — Does the KDL config "unknown keys MUST be rejected" (FR-014) align with extension-loaded decoders potentially declaring their own config keys that the core engine doesn't statically know? [Conflict, Spec §FR-014 vs §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 — Can SC-003 ("under 50MB of resident memory at idle") be objectively measured? RSS is sensitive to allocator behavior, shared libraries, and OS caching — is the measurement methodology specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK025 — Can SC-004 ("playback latency under 10ms") be objectively measured? Latency from "source read to audio output" — is this measured at the `read()` call, the `cpal` callback entry, or the DAC? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 — Can SC-005 ("no more than 6 required methods") be objectively verified given the `Decoder` trait currently has 8 methods? Are `supported_formats()`, `source_requirements()`, `can_decode()`, `open()`, `read()`, `seek()`, `metadata()`, and `output_format()` all counted? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005 vs Contract §Decoder Trait]
- [ ] CHK027 — Is SC-007 ("cold boot under 500ms") measured with or without extension discovery scanning `~/.local/share/around/decoders/`? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK028 — Is SC-008 ("exits cleanly within 500ms of stop command") measured from command receipt to process exit, and does it account for decoder teardown (FFmpeg may flush buffers)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 — Are requirements defined for the scenario where a user sends `play` via IPC while another track is already playing? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK030 — Are requirements defined for the scenario where the IPC client disconnects mid-command (partial JSON message)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK031 — Are requirements defined for the scenario where the KDL config file is malformed (parse error) vs. contains valid KDL with unknown keys? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK032 — Are requirements defined for playback of a file whose format is detected but the corresponding decoder fails to `open()` — should the engine try fallback decoders? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK033 — Are requirements defined for the transition from `Stopped` state to `Playing` — can a stopped track be restarted from the beginning? Does `stop` discard the track? [Gap, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK034 — Are requirements defined for the scenario where `load_decoder_bytes` receives data exceeding available temp space or disk space? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-016b]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK035 — Is the "truncated or corrupted mid-playback" edge case mapped to an explicit requirement specifying the expected error variant, log event, and engine state after the error? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases → FR-010/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK036 — Is the "format detected but decoding fails (DRM-protected, unsupported codec variant)" edge case mapped to an explicit requirement that distinguishes it from "unsupported format"? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases → FR-002/FR-003]
- [ ] CHK037 — Is the "audio output device disconnected during playback" edge case mapped to an explicit requirement for detection, error reporting, and recovery/reconnection behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK038 — Is the "file of zero duration or format that produces no decodable samples" edge case mapped to an explicit requirement — does the engine report success (played nothing), an error, or a warning? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK039 — Is the "seek beyond file duration" edge case mapped to an explicit requirement? The IPC contract defines `INVALID_POSITION` error but the spec edge cases list it as open. [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases vs Contract §IPC Seek]
- [ ] CHK040 — Is the "concurrent commands (rapid seek while playback starting)" edge case mapped to explicit requirements for command queuing, rejection, or serialization? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK041 — Is the "duplicate `load_decoder` for an already-loaded decoder" scenario defined with expected behavior (reject, replace, or ignore)? [Edge Case, Contract §IPC Load Decoder]

## Extension API Stability

- [ ] CHK042 — Is the term "stable Decoder trait" (FR-008) accompanied by concrete stability criteria? The contract correctly marks "Pre-1.0 (may evolve)" but the spec uses "stable" without qualification. [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008 vs Contract §Decoder Trait]
- [ ] CHK043 — Is a versioning policy defined for the `Decoder` trait contract that extension authors can depend on? The contract file declares `Version: 0.1.0-pre` but no policy governs how version numbers change. [Gap, Contract §Decoder Trait]
- [ ] CHK044 — Are requirements defined for backward compatibility when the `Decoder` trait evolves — can an extension compiled against v0.1 load on an engine with v0.2? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK045 — Are requirements defined for the `create_decoder` FFI symbol's ABI stability across engine versions? [Gap, Spec §FR-003a, Research §Extension Loading]
- [ ] CHK046 — Is the `Source` trait held to the same stability criteria as the `Decoder` trait? FR-009 says "stable Source trait" but the contract has no explicit stability versioning. [Consistency, Spec §FR-008 vs §FR-009]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK047 — Are security requirements defined for the IPC socket? Specifically: socket file permissions, authentication of connecting clients, and whether the socket accepts connections from other local users. [Gap, NFR — flagged for post-MVP]
- [ ] CHK048 — Are CLI output accessibility requirements defined? Screen-reader compatibility of error messages, structured vs. human-readable output modes. [Gap, NFR — flagged for post-MVP; per user direction: require explicit deferral after MVP]
- [ ] CHK049 — Are internationalization requirements defined for CLI error messages and help text? [Gap, NFR — flagged for post-MVP]
- [ ] CHK050 — Are requirements defined for the engine's signal handling beyond Ctrl+C? SIGHUP (terminal close), SIGTERM (system shutdown), SIGSTOP/SIGCONT? [Gap, Spec §US1 Scenario 2]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK051 — Is the assumption "extensions can be compiled in statically, linked dynamically, or loaded at runtime — all three modes must exhibit identical call-site performance" validated by a concrete measurement methodology? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK052 — Is the assumption "platform audio output uses existing Rust ecosystem crates where available" validated — does `cpal` meet all platform and latency requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §Audio Output]
- [ ] CHK053 — Is the `tokio` `current_thread` assumption ("<2MB additional RSS") validated with measurements? [Assumption, Research §Async Runtime]
- [ ] CHK054 — Are the external dependency risks documented? `symphonia` (maintenance status, WAV feature stability), `knuffel` (KDL spec compliance gaps), `libloading` (platform-specific edge cases)? [Gap, Plan §Primary Dependencies]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK055 — Does "foreground" in FR-004 imply the engine MUST attach to the terminal's process group so Ctrl+C reaches it, or is it just a process lifetime statement? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK056 — Does the `Source` trait's `open()` return `Box<dyn Read + Send>` conflict with the constitution's "no `dyn Trait` in hot paths"? The source is opened once at pipeline start — is this considered a hot path? [Conflict, Contract §Source Trait vs Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK057 — The decoder contract clause 4 says "Opening the same source twice MAY fail or produce independent decoder instances; either behavior is valid." Is this intentional ambiguity or should it be tightened for extension authors? [Ambiguity, Contract §Decoder Trait §4]
- [ ] CHK058 — The IPC contract uses `"state"` in some responses and `"status"` for the command envelope — is this intentional or a naming inconsistency? [Ambiguity, Contract §IPC Commands]
